entities.name: Treefolk
entities.description: A creature type for sentient trees and guardians of the forests they inhabit.

entities.name: Magnigoth Treefolk
entities.description: Yavimaya's treefolk, among the tallest creatures on Dominaria, who chased the dragon Rith across the plane.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: A Primeval dragon imprisoned in a Magnigoth tree, freed and chased by Magnigoth treefolk to Urborg.

entities.name: Ebony Treefolk
entities.description: Dense, evil-dispositioned treefolk of Urborg that defended it against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Argothian Treefolk
entities.description: Treefolk of Argoth thought extinct after the final battle of the Brothers' War, including the guardians of Gaea's Cradle.

entities.name: Sunrise Brake
entities.description: An organization of mostly rowan treefolk devoted to destroying the unnatural and artificial, who brought down machines during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: The last yew treefolk, whose only offspring, The Sapling, was destroyed by Oona.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The Faerie Queen whom the Sunrise Brake sought and who destroyed The Sapling.

entities.name: Black Oak of Odunos
entities.description: A Zombie Treefolk on Theros created by Phenax.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god of Theros who created the Black Oak of Odunos.

entities.name: Ents
entities.description: Sentient treefolk who protect the trees of Middle-earth in The Lord of the Rings.

entities.name: Lorwyn Treefolk
entities.description: The oldest beings of Lorwyn, born from seedbodies and awakened through the Rising, who once waged war on the kithkin.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane with a vast array of treefolk.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A swampy island-continent home to ebony treefolk where Rith was caught.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane whose treefolk are its oldest beings.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The old forest where Argothian treefolk lived.

events.summary: Ebony treefolk savagely defend Urborg against the Phyrexian invaders.
events.quote: Ebony treefolk savagely defended Urborg against the Phyrexian invaders.

events.summary: After Rith is freed from the Magnigoth tree that imprisoned her, Magnigoth treefolk chase her across Dominaria and catch her in Urborg.
events.quote: a group of Magnigoth treefolk chased her across Dominaria before eventually catching the dragon in Urborg .

events.summary: Argothian treefolk are thought to have become extinct when the final battle of the Brothers' War raged across their forest.
events.quote: The treefolk of the old forest of Argoth are thought to have become extinct when the final battle of the Brothers' War raged across their forest.

events.summary: In the past the treefolk of Lorwyn waged war with the kithkin and ruled much of the plane as dictators.
events.quote: the plane's treefolk waged war with the kithkin and ruled significant portions of the plane as dictators.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Sunrise Brake brings down legions of machines in their wrath.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , they brought down legions of the machines in their wrath.

events.summary: Yew treefolk dwindle until only Colfenor remains, whose offspring The Sapling is destroyed by Oona.
events.quote: until only one remained: Colfenor , the Last Yew; who only produced The Sapling , which was destroyed by Oona .

relations.note: It is a creation of Phenax.
relations.quote: It is a creation of Phenax .
a group of Magnigoth treefolk chased her across Dominaria before eventually catching the dragon in Urborg .

relations.note: Their larger goal was to find the Faerie Queen.
relations.quote: their larger goal was discovering the location of the Faerie Queen, Oona.
